en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European riverside city with grand historic buildings, a curving colonnade and statue in the foreground, a large palace complex on a hill to the left, a wide river with several bridges and boats, and a domed parliament building visible in the far distance along the embankment. A formal park with curved paths and a busy square with trams and horse‑drawn vehicles occupy the lower right.
